newsitem.title: INDIA: India delays suspension of Reliance agent.
newsitem.headline: India delays suspension of Reliance agent.

text.p: India's finance ministry on Friday delayed the suspension of the share registrar and transfer agent for Reliance Industries Ltd, a company official said.

Market regulator the Securities and Exchange Board of India (SEBI), had ordered the suspension of Reliance Consultancy Services Ltd (RCS) for six months beginning February 1, 1997 for what it said were improper share swaps.
"Till the final disposal of the appeal...by Reliance Consultancy Services Ltd, the finance ministry has stayed the order of SEBI," the official said in a statement.

The SEBI had ordered the suspension in October but delayed its taking effect to enable RCS make alternate arrangements to service the registry and share transfer needs of shareholders of the Reliance group.
The petrochemicals giant has 2.6 million shareholders.
